name: Are pre-construction deposits held in escrow?

mainEntity.name: Are pre-construction deposits held in escrow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in Florida, pre-construction deposits are typically required to be held in an escrow account, often by the developer's attorney or a title company. This protects your funds by ensuring they are not released to the developer until certain conditions are met, such as construction milestones or closing. This escrow requirement provides a layer of security for buyers, and Kelby Contreras always verifies these details for clients acquiring properties throughout Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, and Orange Counties.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Florida, pre-construction deposits are typically held in an escrow account to protect buyer funds until specific conditions are met.
